01Why now

Why this course, and why now

AI now drafts plans, tracks risks and summarises status. A good manager still sets the goal, owns the trade-offs and keeps the team moving. This course covers the core methods, and how to use AI without losing control of the work.

02Outcomes

What you will be able to do

Plan the work

Write a clear charter, scope, schedule and risk list.

Run delivery

Run Agile and Scrum teams, and report status that people trust.

Improve operations

Map processes and find the bottleneck in operations and supply chains.

Use AI well

Use AI for plans and reports while checking and owning the result.

04The lab

A project, planned and run

Plan and run a small project from charter to review, using AI for drafts and checking each one. One project, built in steps after each lesson. Each step has instructions, a finished example, a health check, and saves on your device.

The steps

  1. Write the charter
  2. Build the plan and schedule
  3. Write the risk register
  4. Run two sprints on a board
  5. Build the status report
  6. Hold the review and write what you learned

What the health check looks for

  • Every task has an owner and a date
  • Every risk has a response
  • You checked each AI-written plan and report

06Certificate

A certificate you can verify and share

When you meet the criteria you can claim a certificate with its own credential ID and a public page anyone can open to verify it. Add it to LinkedIn in one click, share it, or save it as a PDF.

To earn it

  1. Finish every lesson
  2. Complete every lab step and pass its health checks
  3. Answer at least 70% of the check questions correctly, on the first try or in review

What you get

  • A credential ID and a public page that confirms it
  • Add to LinkedIn in one click
  • Share on LinkedIn, X or Facebook, or copy the link
  • Save as a PDF

Intellica certificates show that you finished this course. They are not accredited qualifications and do not lead to any outside certification.
